result.reason: The clause appropriately extends use rights to Affiliates and contractors and removes Vendor’s unilateral revocation right. However, it expressly remains non-transferable, so it does not permit transfer to successors or even to a successor in an M&A transaction, as required by both positions. It also does not expressly make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable, and compliance with the subscription termination standard depends on unseen Section 13.3. The drafting is otherwise concise and preserves the underlying licence scope.
